messages:
olivia: Quick sync from the Observe pilot planning call. We need a crisp pilot acceptance checklist for PartnerX + 2 small tenants. They care about: simple dashboard setup, per-route cost signal, trace <-> request linking, and an automated error alert baseline. Can we agree scope for pilot only (not full GA)?

maria: Agree pilot-only. Suggest we limit retention to 7 days and deterministic sampling to keep infra cost bounded. If pilot metrics validate, we expand retention in Phase B.

raf: Sales note: PartnerX expects export to S3 and CSV-able costs. They also want a single-pane dashboard for ops. Export can be gated as an opt-in. Important: we must surface any known accuracy caveats up-front.

jon: Implementation thoughts:
- Dashboard: one-click instantiate with tenant-scoped templates + prefilled KPI queries.
- Cost attribution: attribute to model_route by token-count heuristics, mark as "estimated".
- Trace linking: add `x-rw-request-id` and attach `model_route` tag on sampled traces. Deterministic sample: hash(request_id) % 100 < sample_pct.

xi: For tagging, we'll add a small header pipeline change. PR earliest Wed. Risk: batching/prefix-cache will skew per-request tokens. We should add a reconciliation script: `python scripts/reconcile_costs.py --tenant $T` (returning per-route delta).

maria: Pilot acceptance proposal (short):
- 3 tenants successfully instantiate dashboard template via UI.
- Per-route/day cost shown and reconciles to billing within 15% (reconciliation script available).
- Sampled traces include request_id + model_route and link to the dashboard trace viewer.
- Alert baseline: system raises an alert when error-rate delta > X over baseline (configurable).
- No customer PII logged.

raf: Sales gate: confirm S3 export + ability to sign an NDA for PartnerX (they want logs stored for 7 days). If we push retention beyond 7 days for them, need legal approval.

olivia: Decision: keep pilot scope tight. Push full 90-day retention, RBAC tenant rollups, and eval-driven regression alerts to Phase B. Pilot: dashboard templates, estimated cost, trace linking, basic alert baseline, S3 export opt-in (7 days).

jon: UX ask: need quick onboarding flow copy. Proposed microcopy: "Installs dashboard with prefilled KPIs: Cost, Latency P95, Error Rate. Costs shown as estimated (affected by batching/caching)." Should we surface the reconciliation button?

maria: Yes — add a small "Reconcile with billing" button that runs the reconcile script and shows delta. If delta > 15% show a tooltip: "Investigate: batching/prefix cache may affect token attribution."

infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: observe-trace-agent v0.3.2 -> staging at 02:40 UTC. Smoke tests: link https://ci.internal/obs/1734506789 :white_check_mark:.

xi: Timeline: sprint 1 agent header + tagging; sprint 2 backend cost API + reconcile script; sprint 3 UI templates + onboarding copy. Can deliver pilot alpha after sprint 3 if no scope creep.

raf: Can we add pilot success metrics for sales sign-off? My suggestions:
- 3 tenants onboarded and using dashboards for 2+ weeks
- Cost delta < 15% for those tenants or documented explanation
- Support ticket response SLA for the pilot: 24h for P1, 72h for P2.

olivia: Good. Action items:
- Xi: PR for header tagging + sample algo by Wed.
- Jon: wireframe + microcopy for onboarding flow.
- Maria: write Pilot acceptance doc and link reconcile script.
- Raf: confirm PartnerX NDA and S3 export ask with legal.

maria: I'll post the short pilot acceptance checklist in Confluence and ping you all. If any customer asks beyond pilot scope, please raise here so we can decide Phase A vs Phase B. :spiral_calendar:

olivia: Thanks team 680. We'll regroup after artifacts are pushed and lock dates for the pilot start.
